en.headline: Labour Department sanctions two firms over imported labour applications
en.dek: Shengshi Investment Management and Ho Fu Kee Noodle House in Tsuen Wan had their applications halted and face a two-year ban after refusing qualified local job seekers for dishwasher posts.
body: The Labour Department announced on Monday that it has imposed administrative sanctions on Shengshi Investment Management Limited and Ho Fu Kee Noodle House (Tsuen Wan) Limited for breaches of the Enhanced Supplementary Labour Scheme rules while applying to import dishwashers.

The department said it will immediately suspend processing of the companies' existing applications and refuse to process any further applications they submit under the scheme for the next two years. Shengshi was found to have added recruitment conditions without the department's consent, submitted false results of local open recruitment, and refused to hire qualified job seekers without reasonable grounds. Ho Fu Kee Noodle House refused to hire qualified local job seekers without reasonable grounds.

A spokesman emphasised that employers applying to import labour under the scheme must strictly follow the rules, including giving priority to suitable local workers. Breaches of labour or immigration laws, the scheme rules or the standard employment contract can lead to suspension of applications, revocation of approvals already granted, and refusal to process future applications.
The measures aim to ensure the scheme is applied fairly and to protect employment opportunities for local workers.

zh.headline: 勞工處制裁兩公司 中止輸入洗碗員申請兩年
zh.dek: 盛世投資管理及荃灣何富記麵家因無合理理由拒絕聘用合資格本地求職者等違規，即時中止申請並禁未來兩年再申請。
body: 勞工處周一宣布，對盛世投資管理有限公司及何富記麵家（荃灣）有限公司實施行政制裁。兩間公司在根據「補充勞工優化計劃」申請輸入洗碗員期間違反規定。
勞工處即時中止處理兩間公司已提交的申請，並由即日起拒絕處理它們未來兩年在優化計劃下提交的申請。盛世投資在未獲處方同意下新增招聘條件、提交不實的本地公開招聘結果，並無合理理由拒絕聘用合資格求職者；何富記麵家（荃灣）同樣無合理理由拒絕聘用合資格本地求職者。
發言人強調，經優化計劃申請輸入勞工的僱主必須嚴格遵守規定，包括優先聘用合適的本地勞工。若違反勞工或入境法例、計劃規定或標準僱傭合約，處方可中止申請、撤銷已批批准，以及拒絕處理其後申請。
有關措施旨在確保計劃公平執行，保障本地勞工就業機會。
